Synopsis:
SLB (world's largest oilfield services company) is acquiring cooling equipment maker Kelvion from Apollo Global and Triton funds for $3.4B cash + ~$700M assumed debt. Deal targets data center thermal management, driven by AI infrastructure buildout. Combined data center unit projected to generate $4.5–$5B revenue and $700–$800M EBITDA by 2028. SLB also has active partnerships with Liberty Energy and Nvidia, signaling a deliberate strategic pivot toward AI/data center infrastructure.
